Software Dev Engineer I, Amazon University Talent Acquisition

Job ID: 10517917 | ADCI - Karnataka

This role is intended for 2026 and 2025 graduates only.

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of customers. Software Development Engineers use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems that affect millions of customers, sellers, and products. The role involves creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and working at a fast pace.

Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams to design and bring innovative products and services to market.
• Design and build technologies in a large distributed computing environment.
• Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems at scale and speed.
• Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage.
• Design and code solutions to broadly defined problems.
• Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field.
- Knowledge of object-oriented design, algorithms, data structures, problem solving, and complexity analysis.
- Knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++, Python, Java, or Perl.

Preferred Qualifications
- Previous technical internship(s).
- Experience with distributed, multi-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases.
- Experience in linear programming or nonlinear optimization.
- Ability to articulate technical challenges and solutions.
- Ability to handle ambiguous problems and think abstractly.

Software Engineer — Qualys Sensor Platform

Location: Pune | Full time | Job ID: R0005062

Qualys is a provider of cloud-based IT security and compliance solutions. The Software Engineer will work on the Qualys Sensor Platform, contributing to the prototyping, design, development, and support of a scalable security platform focused on Windows.

Responsibilities
- Analyze, design, code, and debug security software for Windows.
- Maintain, support, and enhance existing systems and platforms.
- Recommend continuous improvements.
- Work with engineers to apply development best practices.
- Collaborate with senior engineers and architects to implement features and resolve defects.

Required Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
- 1 to 3 years of hands-on experience developing software products.
- At least 1 year of C++ programming in a Windows environment.
- Knowledge of Windows internals, including processes, threads, services, registry, and Win32 API.
- Skills in design, prototyping, development, unit testing, and performance profiling.
- Experience with tools such as Visual Studio, Git, and Jira, and Agile/Scrum development.

Desired Skills
- Ownership of successful delivery of product components.
- Exposure to Test-Driven Development and a strong quality focus.
- Strong verbal and written communication.
- Self-directed with minimal supervision.
- Collaborative, quality-focused team player.

Backend and Middleware Engineer — Apple

Description
- Design and develop frameworks that process high-volume transactions with Apple's partners.
- Use sound judgment and technical leadership to enhance and scale B2B platforms.
- Develop solutions that optimize availability and consistency across data centers and cloud providers.
- Build frameworks for persistence, event processing, uniqueness, transaction correlation, and notifications.
- Work with project developers, operations, and systems engineers.

Minimum Qualifications
- More than 2 years of experience building frameworks using middleware such as Apache Camel.
- More than 8 years of Java programming for middleware or backend applications.
- More than 5 years using Java frameworks such as Spring.
- Strong object-oriented design and analysis skills.
- More than 5 years working with Oracle or similar relational databases and NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
- More than 5 years designing scalable, reliable solutions using distributed system architecture.
- Knowledge of HTTP/S, TCP, DNS, and web application load balancing.
- Knowledge of JVMs, operating systems, file systems, network protocols, and security concepts including authentication, authorization, signing, encryption, SSL/TLS, SSH/SFTP, PKI, X509 certificates, and PGP.
- Experience tuning application and database performance.

Preferred Qualifications
- Knowledge of Bash or Perl.
- Cloud integration experience is a plus.
- Familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals is a plus.
- Agile development experience.
- Ownership, problem solving, collaboration, communication, and ability to handle ambiguity.
- Ability to lead large projects and achieve strong results.
